page.overview:
Who is Jacqui Briggs?

Muay Thai (MKX, MK11) Boxing (MKX, MK11)}}

Sergeant Jacqueline Sonya "Jacqui" Briggs is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A member of the Special Forces, she is also the daughter of Jax Briggs. She, alongside Cassie Cage, Takeda, and Kung Jin are known collectively as the Kombat Kids.

Jacqui made her first appearance in the Mortal Kombat X comic series. She makes her playable debut in Mortal Kombat X, serving as one of the protagonists in the game's Story Mode.

A close friend to Cassie Cage, Jacqui Briggs is the daughter of Jackson Briggs and Vera Briggs. After Jax was resurrected from being one of Quan Chi's slaves during the Netherrealm War, he met Vera and they went onto marry, the two becoming parents to Jacqui. After her birth, he became overly protective of Jacqui and wanted her to live a normal life. At some point, Jacqui became a professional kickboxer and eventually competed in the Junior Olympics and enlisted in a training camp. Despite her father not approving of her decision to join the Special Forces, Jacqui sees it as her duty to protect Earthrealm and to avenge her father from the suffering he endured from Quan Chi and Ermac (who ripped off Jax's arms during the Outworld tournament).
